[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docs/README.md#-document-template]

### 📋 Document Template

When creating new documentation, follow this structure:

```markdown
# Document Title

Brief description of the document's purpose and scope.

## Table of Contents

- Auto-generated or manual TOC

## Overview

High-level summary

## [Main Sections]

Detailed content with examples

## Related Documents

Links to related documentation

## Support

How to get help with this topic
````
